inputs.price_source: Yahoo Finance chart API regularMarketPrice for ELE, 15.60 USD, Nasdaq, 2026-10-27 14:20 UTC
inputs.fcf_source: FY2025 cash flows from operating activities 30,811,000 USD divided by 63,829,995 shares outstanding at 2025-12-31. IFRS tags CashFlowsFromUsedInOperatingActivities and NumberOfSharesOutstanding, Form 40-F accession 0001628280-26-020856. This is reported 2025 operating cash, not a normalized post-merger run rate. Property, plant and equipment purchases were 4,000 USD. Cash used in investing activities was 56,325,000 USD and is not deducted here because it is portfolio investment, not sustaining plant.
inputs.shares_source: IFRS NumberOfSharesOutstanding 63,829,995 at 2025-12-31, Form 40-F accession 0001628280-26-020856. Weighted average shares were 29,975,215. Ending shares are used so the per-share figure is not inflated by the pre-merger average.

bear.notes: [Assumption] Operating cash declines and the selling multiple compresses. Not a filing forecast.

base.notes: [Assumption] Flat operating cash and a 15 times selling multiple. The September 2026 Orion transaction is not in this cash number.

bull.notes: [Assumption] Modest growth and a higher selling multiple. Not a filing forecast.
